prompts.name: Blood Moon
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium lunar cutout for a health and life-science web app, displayed at about 180 pixels wide.
Primary request: One literal eclipsed blood moon, elegant and restrained, with a clean perfectly spherical silhouette and subtle believable lunar surface detail.
Scene/backdrop: Genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha; the moon is the only object.
Subject and materials: A solid rocky lunar sphere, mostly in shadow. Its charcoal and deep burgundy hemisphere remains faintly readable; a restrained dark garnet and copper-red illuminated crescent and soft terminator reveal extremely fine, subdued lunar texture. Very restrained cratering and natural lunar maria, avoiding busy high-contrast surface detail.
Style/medium: Sophisticated astronomical photography with quiet studio-quality tonal control, natural matte mineral surface, exceptional realism and elegant small-scale legibility.
Composition/framing: Square composition, one centered moon occupying roughly 64 percent of the canvas width, generous completely transparent padding on every side.
Lighting/mood: Dim, dramatic, quiet eclipse illumination. Gentle controlled transition from dusky copper and garnet light into near-black burgundy shadow, soft highlight restraint and no specular shine.
Color palette: Matte oxblood, charcoal, dark garnet, muted copper red and dusty rose undertones, suitable over an oxblood-charcoal interface.
Constraints: Make this recognizably the Moon, not a generic sphere. Preserve a crisp clean circular silhouette. No glass, membrane, liquid, glossy orb, metallic shine, neon halo, outer glow, lens flare, stars, background scene, typography, logo, watermark, or extra objects. True alpha transparency outside the lunar silhouette; no baked checkerboard or opaque backdrop.

prompts.name: Royal Purple
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original visual identity artwork for an elite life-science health application, NOT a UI or poster. Portrait 4:5 macro studio photograph of an abstract biological lamella sculpture made from exceptionally thin translucent amethyst glass and a velvet-violet folded membrane, irregular graceful nested folds suggesting cellular architecture rather than a flower. A few incredibly fine champagne-gold edges catch the light, no jewels or crown. One coherent sculptural specimen, asymmetrical architectural silhouette, optical depth, exquisite real microtexture, sophisticated editorial luxury. Palette: almost-black aubergine #100e17, royal violet, translucent orchid highlights, restrained champagne detail. Place the object in the upper-right two-thirds of the frame with luxurious quiet nearly black negative space on the left third and lower quarter for application text. Gallery-quality directional lighting, sharp selected contours, soft falloff and velvety shadow. Bold enough to be distinctive, rigorously composed. No lettering, symbols, labels, logos, UI, watermarks, literal DNA, generic chrome sphere, rainbow gradients, glitter, gemstone clip art or ornamental luxury clichés.

prompts.name: Silverbolt
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium life-science application brand artwork, not a screen mockup. Portrait 4:5 high-end macro product photograph of a singular flowing platinum lamella sculpture: a thin silver sheet folds and unfurls into an elegant asymmetric crescent-like cellular shell with a dark hollow core, brushed platinum outside and finely frosted optical glass inner surfaces. Architectural, precise, sophisticated, biomorphic yet engineered. Real small-scale surface detail and carefully controlled glints, a tiny icy pale-cyan reflection along one seam. Palette: warm neutral graphite black #111214, platinum silver, frosted gray, minimal icy cyan. Object positioned mostly in upper-right two-thirds; left third and lower quarter quiet dark graphite negative space for text. Sculptural silhouette should be recognizable at small size, no noisy details. Cinematic directional museum studio lighting with rich readable shadows. No text, no logos, no UI, no lightning bolt icon, no DNA spiral, no generic chrome torus or sphere, no rainbow chrome, no cyberpunk, no glitter, no futuristic machinery. Distinctive elegant precision for a modern scientific brand.

prompts.name: Moonshine
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art-directed luxury life-science identity photograph, NOT a website screenshot. Portrait 4:5. Create a bold abstract pearlescent biomaterial sculpture: two or three dramatically folded, impossibly thin translucent membranes intersect and curl into an asymmetric open crescent with a sculptural central void. Think experimental cellular film seen through a magnificent macro lens, not a literal shell, flower, moon, or sphere. Milky nacre, frosted opal, silky lilac refraction, surprising rich plum shadow pockets and a very restrained blush-peach caustic. Rich physical material, subtle microtexture, sophisticated editorial object photography, strong flowing silhouette. Palette: pearl ivory #f2edf3, luminous silver-white, vivid but tasteful lavender, deeper aubergine and muted rose. Place sculpture in upper-right two-thirds, leave left third and bottom quarter airy nearly-white pearl negative space for dark interface typography. Gallery studio light, bright luminous highlights, tactile believable surface and clear contrast. Creative, abstract, otherworldly, elite and life-scientific. No text, no logos, no UI, no literal moon landscape, no DNA helix, no generic white sphere, no gradient blob, no rainbow candy, no glitter, no hazy pastel fog, no extra props.
